audit.current_question:
In the figure, D lies on AB and angle AOB equals angle DOC. Find the measure of angle DOB.
Choices:
A:40°
B:30°
C:38°
D:15°
audit.adaptation_reason: With only AOD30° and AOC100°, the source does not determine rayOB, despite D being onAB. Added the single equality AOB=DOC, preserving the original40° answer, target, and visible line graph.
source_visual_observations: RaysOA,OD,OB,OC appear in that order; D lies onAB; DC also drawn; AOD30° and wholeAOC100°.
audit.independent_solution: AOC=100° and AOD=30° give DOC=70°. The added equality AOB=DOC makes AOB=70°. Hence DOB=AOB−AOD=70−30=40°, choice A.
